General Qualifications

  • High School graduate and 18 years old or older

  • Fluent English (reading and writing)

Content Moderator

This mod’s job is to ensure quality content in the sub. One way to do this is to encourage good content by upvoating, commenting on, discussing, or posting good content.

Another side is to discourage poor content. Again, this could be done via downvoats, comments, discussion, or worst case: deletion. This mod ensures that content posted meets the sub’s rules and if not, takes appropriate action, determined in advance and agreed upon by the mods. This may include warnings, private messages and / or content deletion. In extreme cases, it may include informing the site administrators.

One additional qualification is you must be located in a Western time zone (America’s, Western Europe). You should also be available for at least a few minutes every day to make sure the sub is not being spammed etc. If the workload becomes too much, we will look for additional content moderators.

CSS Moderator

The CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) moderator will be responsible for maintaining and improving the sub’s CSS. Major changes will be discussed or tested in test subs, but otherwise the mod will have pretty much free reign. Prior experience with graphic design, web design or CSS in particular is a big plus and will put you at the top of the list. If you are not familiar with CSS, this is not for you.

If you do a great job with the sub’s CSS, you can use this for resumes and provide concrete examples of your work. At the very least you get some great practice and an audience of 14,000!

Conclusion

If you think you have what it takes to be a moderator of /v/nsfw, send me a private message with:

  • Introduction

  • Moderating experience, if any (newbies are ok too)

  • Why you think you would make a good Content / CSS mod

  • Proof of high school graduation and age (don’t need any personal info, feel free to black stuff out).
